_meta.description: Heart event #2 for npc_leera: The Injury

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [You find Leera limping on the path from the ruins]

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: I'm FINE. It's just a — ow. Okay, maybe not fine.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Stupid loose rock. Twisted my ankle in the ruins.

options.text: Lean on me. I'll get you back.
This is why you shouldn't go alone.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: I don't need — okay. Fine. Thank you.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Don't tell Harrow. He'll lecture me for a WEEK.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: ...You came looking for me, didn't you?

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Nobody does that. Usually I just... handle it myself.
